name: NIGHT SPREAD TRAP (why vendor set files do not transfer brokers)
notes: Deliberately a dead preset, and the most instructive one here. Same strategy, same geometry, but the window sits on the 22:00 bank rollover with the documented MaxSpread default of 5 points. Spreads there routinely run 0.8-2.5 pips, so the spread gate refuses every bar and the bot never trades — or, on a broker with loose spread reporting, it trades right into the widest, slipperiest minute of the day and the 98% tester win rate arrives live as 88%. Either way the ONLY thing that changed versus quiet-eve-low is the clock and the broker. That is what 'works with any broker' means. Note: with slBeyondRangePips left on, the break-even rail refuses this shape before the spread gate is even consulted (TP 14 against a stop widened to 34p needs 74.1%) — which is the right outcome for that geometry but the wrong lesson here, because this fixture exists to show that a broker's spread alone can zero a strategy. The widening is off so the spread does the refusing.
